title: Inversion and Emphasis / Inversiɔn ne jògɔra
bridge: A taali gian, jògɔra b'a tun ani b'a ka particles banda ka ''sí que'' wala ''es que'', nka, a taali gi, jògɔra b'a tun bɔ subject-verb tɔgɔ laban bɔ b'a ka ''not only... but also'' wala ''so + adjective... that'' tɛmɛ fana. An ka tɔɔrɔbɔriw bɛɛ se ka sɔrɔ ka taa a taali gi, fɔlɔ fɔlɔ a bɛna ka subject-verb tɔgɔ laban, nka, a taali gi, fɔlɔ fɔlɔ a bɛna ka tɛmɛw kelen ka ''Not only he arrived late'' tɛmɛ fana, o b'a ka ''Not only did he arrive late''.
rule: A taali gi, inversiɔn b'a tun jògɔra wala fɔlɔw filɛ nin ka bɛɛ. A bɛnna ka: 1) Adverbs ka ''never'', ''rarely'', ''seldom'', ''hardly'', ''scarcely'', ''no sooner'', ''not only'', ''not until'', ''little'', ''in no way'' ka bɛɛ ka ban. An ka tɛmɛw, auxiliary (do/does/did, have/has, will, etc.) bɛna ka subject se ka ban, verb tɛmɛna ka ''to'' ka ban. Tɛmɛ: ''Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.'' 2) ''So + adjective/adverb'' ne ''such + noun'' bɛna ka tɛmɛyɛ ka ban ka ''that'' (''that'' b'a ta fan fɔlɔw filɛ nin ka bɛɛ): ''So beautiful was the painting that everyone stared.'' 3) ''Not only... but also'', ''only after'', ''only if'' tɛmɛw ka bɛɛ ka ban. 4) Conditional tɛmɛw fɔlɔw filɛ nin ka bɛɛ, subject ne verb bɛna ka ''if'' se ka ban: ''Had I known, I would have come.'' 5) ''Here'' ne ''there'' bɛna ka intransitive verb ne subject noun ka bɛɛ, o b'a ta pronoun. 6) ''May'' bɛna ka desire tɛmɛw fɔlɔw filɛ nin ka bɛɛ. Fɔlɔw filɛ: a taali gi, inversiɔn b'a tun declarative tɛmɛw kelen (a taali gi, questions wala exclamations tɛmɛw ka bɛɛ), o b'a ta questions tɛmɛw ka ban. Fɔlɔ fɔlɔ, inversiɔn ne negative adverbs bɛna ka auxiliaries tɔɔrɔ, verbs tɛmɛw ka bɛɛ ka simple tenses.

concept_examples.text: Never have I encountered such a challenging problem.
concept_examples.translation: Manti mɔgɔ min na ka taa ka fɔlɔ fana ka taa ka tɔgɔ.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər hæv aɪ ɪnˈkaʊntərd sʌtʃ ə ˈtʃælɪndʒɪŋ ˈprɒbləm/

concept_examples.text: Not only did she lose her job, but she also had to relocate.
concept_examples.translation: A yɛrɛ taa ka taa ka tɔgɔ, o bɛɛ a yɛrɛ taa ka taa ka tɔgɔ fana.
concept_examples.phonetic: /nɒt ˈəʊnli dɪd ʃiː luːz hɜː dʒɒb bʌt ʃiː ˈɔːlsəʊ hæd tə ˌriːləʊˈkeɪt/

concept_examples.text: So intense was the heat that the roads began to melt.
concept_examples.translation: Jɔgɔ bɛɛ ka taa ka tɔgɔ, taa ka taa ka tɔgɔ bɛɛ.
concept_examples.phonetic: /səʊ ɪnˈtens wɒz ðə hiːt ðæt ðə rəʊdz bɪˈɡæn tə melt/

concept_examples.text: Only after the war did the country experience true reconstruction.
concept_examples.translation: Hɛrɛ ka taa ka tɔgɔ, taa ka taa ka tɔgɔ bɛɛ.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈəʊnli ˈæftə ðə wɔː dɪd ðə ˈkʌntri ɪkˈspɪəriəns truː ˌriːkənˈstrʌkʃən/

common_error.wrong: Not only he has a beautiful voice, but also he sings well.
common_error.correct: Not only does he have a beautiful voice, but he also sings well.
common_error.correct_alt: Not only does he have a beautiful voice, but he also sings well.
common_error.explanation: Jalbanya bɛ se ka taa a taali gian, o bɛ se ka ''No solo él tiene una voz hermosa, sino que además canta bien'', subject-verb tɔgɔ laban. Nka, a taali gi, ''not only'' bɛna ka tɛmɛyɛ ka ban, auxiliary ne subject tɔgɔ laban bɛna. Bɛɛ, ''does'' auxiliary bɛna ka present simple, verb tɛmɛna ka base form. Fɔlɔw filɛ, inversiɔn b'a ta fan a taali gi sintaks ka taa ka ban. Jalbanya kɔrɔ, ''not only'', ''never'', ''rarely'' tɛmɛw ka bɛɛ ka ban: auxiliary + subject + verb tɛmɛna.

examples.original: Never have I seen such a dedicated team.
examples.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər hæv aɪ siːn sʌtʃ ə ˈdɛdɪkeɪtɪd tiːm/
examples.translation: Manti mɔgɔ min na ka taa ka fɔlɔ fana ka taa ka tɔgɔ.
examples.note: ''Never'' bɛna ka tɛmɛyɛ ka ban, ''have'' ne ''I'' tɔgɔ laban. A taali gi, o b'a ta ''Nunca he visto''.

examples.original: Rarely do we find such an honest politician.
examples.phonetic: /ˈreəli duː wiː faɪnd sʌtʃ ən ˈɒnɪst ˌpɒlɪˈtɪʃən/
examples.translation: Hɛrɛ ka taa ka tɔgɔ, taa ka taa ka tɔgɔ bɛɛ.
examples.note: ''Rarely'' bɛna ka tɛmɛyɛ ka ban, ''do'' auxiliary bɛna ka present simple, ''find'' verb tɛmɛna ka infinitive.

examples.original: Hardly had we left the house when it started to rain.
examples.phonetic: /ˈhɑːdli hæd wiː lɛft ðə haʊs wɛn ɪt ˈstɑːtɪd tə reɪn/
examples.translation: Hardly we had left home when it started raining.
examples.note: ''Hardly... when'' tɛmɛ b'a tun ka taa ka tɔgɔ bɛnna ka past perfect ne inversiɔn.

examples.original: So tired was she that she fell asleep instantly.
examples.phonetic: /səʊ ˈtaɪəd wɒz ʃiː ðæt ʃiː fɛl əˈsliːp ˈɪnstəntli/
examples.translation: Jɔgɔ bɛɛ ka taa ka tɔgɔ, taa ka taa ka tɔgɔ bɛɛ.
examples.note: ''So + adjective + was/were + subject + that'' tɛmɛ b'a tun jògɔra ka taa ka tɔgɔ. A taali gi, o b'a ta ''tan... que'' ne inversiɔn.

examples.original: Such was the noise that nobody could sleep.
examples.phonetic: /sʌtʃ wɒz ðə nɔɪz ðæt ˈnəʊbədi kʊd sliːp/
examples.translation: Such was the noise that no one could sleep.
examples.note: ''Such'' bɛna ka noun ka ban ka tɛmɛyɛ ka ban. ''Such'' b'a ta adjective, ''was'' bɛna ka subject se ka ban.

examples.original: So quickly did she finish that everyone was amazed.
examples.phonetic: /səʊ ˈkwɪkli dɪd ʃiː ˈfɪnɪʃ ðæt ˈɛvrɪwʌn wɒz əˈmeɪzd/
examples.translation: So quickly did she finish that everyone was amazed.
examples.note: Adverb (''quickly'') bɛna ka adjective se ka ban, ''did'' auxiliary bɛna ka verb tɛmɛna ne infinitive.

levels.label: Conditional Inversion and Formal Structures
levels.translation: Conditional inversiɔn ne fɔlɔw filɛ nin ka bɛɛ

examples.original: Had I known about the delay, I would have left earlier.
examples.phonetic: /hæd aɪ nəʊn əˈbaʊt ðə dɪˈleɪ aɪ wʊd hæv lɛft ˈɜːliə/
examples.translation: If I had known about the delay, I would have left earlier.
examples.note: Conditional fɔlɔw filɛ nin ka bɛɛ, ''if'' b'a ta fan, subject ne ''had'' tɔgɔ laban. ''If I had known...'' ka taa ka tɔgɔ.

examples.original: Should you need any assistance, do not hesitate to call us.
examples.phonetic: /ʃʊd juː niːd ˈɛni əˈsɪstəns duː nɒt ˈhɛzɪteɪt tə kɔːl ʌs/
examples.translation: Should you need any help, do not hesitate to call us.
examples.note: ''Should'' bɛna ka ''if'' se ka ban ka fɔlɔw filɛ nin ka bɛɛ. A taali gi, o b'a ta ''si necesitara''.

examples.original: No sooner had the concert started than the fire alarm went off.
examples.phonetic: /nəʊ ˈsuːnə hæd ðə ˈkɒnsət ˈstɑːtɪd ðæn ðə ˈfaɪər əˈlɑːm wɛnt ɒf/
examples.translation: No sooner had the concert begun than the fire alarm went off.
examples.note: ''No sooner... than'' tɛmɛ b'a tun ka taa ka tɔgɔ bɛnna ka past perfect ne inversiɔn.

examples.original: Were the government to propose such a law, it would be highly controversial.
examples.phonetic: /wɜː ðə ˈɡʌvənmənt tə prəˈpəʊz sʌtʃ ə lɔː ɪt wʊd biː ˈhaɪli ˌkɒntrəˈvɜːʃəl/
examples.translation: Were the government to propose such a law, it would be highly controversial.
examples.note: Conditional fɔlɔw filɛ nin ka bɛɛ ne ''were + subject + to + infinitive'' tɛmɛ b'a tun ''if + past simple'' se ka ban.

title: Register and Style: Formal, Informal, and Neutral / Kɔfale, Kɔfale Kanubali, n'a Kanu Kɛlɛya
bridge: A taali gi, kɔfale bɛ se ka k'a yira ko i ka lamɛn waati bɛ yira 'tú'/'usted' la, amma a taali gi, kɔfale kanu bɛ se ka k'a yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi, sintaksika dɔmɔsi, n'i ka fɔlɔw kanubaliw dɔw kan. Kɔfale kanubaliw ka lamɛn bɛ yira ko i ka lamɛn waati bɛ yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsiw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la, amma a taali gi, i ka lamɛn waati bɛ yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la, i ka lamɛn waati bɛ yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la. K'a yira ko 'I am writing to you in order to request...' a bɛ yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubali, amma 'I'm writing to ask...' a bɛ yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la. K'a yira ko i ka lamɛn waati bɛ yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la, a bɛ se ka k'a yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la.
rule: A taali gi C1, kɔfale bɛ se ka k'a yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la: leksikili (e.g., 'get' vs 'obtain', 'show' vs 'demonstrate'), gramatikili (pasiva dɔmɔsi, klaùsula dɔmɔsi, kondisionali) n'a pragmatikili (fɔmulasi ka kɔfale, atenuadori). Kɔfale kanubali bɛ se ka k'a yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la, akadamisi ka texisi, kɔfale ka leti, rapɔri; i ka lamɛn waati bɛ yira pasiva ('It was decided...'), latinka verbi, n'i ka fɔlɔw kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la ('furthermore', 'nevertheless'). Kɔfale kanubali bɛ se ka k'a yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la, kɛlɛya ka discusii, ka kɔfale ka mesaji; i ka lamɛn waati bɛ yira kontrasi, frasali verbi (e.g., 'put off' aw ka 'postpone'), n'i ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubali. Kɔfale kɛlɛya bɛ se ka k'a yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la: klaru, direkitu, jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubali. C1, a bɛ se ka k'a yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la, n'a bɛ se ka k'a yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la.

concept_examples.text: I would be grateful if you could provide me with further details.
concept_examples.translation: Ayɛ k'a mɛn fɔlɔw k'a fɔlɔw i ka dɔmɔsiw k'a fɔlɔw.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd biː ˈɡreɪtfʊl ɪf juː kʊd prəˈvaɪd miː wɪð ˈfɜːðər ˈdiːteɪlz/

concept_examples.text: Could you send me the report by Friday?
concept_examples.translation: A ka tɛmɛ k'a mɛn fɔlɔw k'a fɔlɔw i ka rapɔri k'a fɔlɔw?
concept_examples.phonetic: /kʊd juː sɛnd miː ðə rɪˈpɔːrt baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ/

concept_examples.text: No worries, I'll get back to you later.
concept_examples.translation: Mɛn k'a fɔlɔw, ayɛ k'a mɛn fɔlɔw k'a fɔlɔw.
concept_examples.phonetic: /nəʊ ˈwʌriz aɪl ɡɛt bæk tə juː ˈleɪtər/

common_error.wrong: I am writing this in order to ask you for a favor, because I need to know if you can help me with the presentation.
common_error.correct: I'm writing to ask a favor – could you help me with the presentation?
common_error.correct_alt: I'm writing to ask you a favor: would you be able to help me with the presentation?
common_error.explanation: Kɔfale kanubaliw ka lamɛn bɛ yira ko i ka lamɛn waati bɛ yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la ( 'I am writing this in order to ask') n'a bɛ yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la ('because I need to know'). A taali gi, a bɛ se ka k'a yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la. K'a yira ko i ka lamɛn waati bɛ yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la, a bɛ se ka k'a yira kontrasi n'i ka fɔlɔw kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la; k'a yira ko i ka lamɛn waati bɛ yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la, a bɛ se ka k'a yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la, n'a bɛ se ka k'a yira kontrasi. Kɔfale kanubaliw ka lamɛn bɛ yira ko i ka lamɛn waati bɛ yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la.

examples.original: The company has decided to implement a new policy.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈkʌmpəni hæz dɪˈsaɪdɪd tuː ˈɪmplɪmɛnt ə njuː ˈpɒləsi/
examples.translation: Jaabi bɛ yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la.
examples.note: Pasiva dɔmɔsi dɔmɔsiw ka lamɛn waati bɛ yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la. A bɛ se ka k'a yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la.

examples.original: We regret to inform you that your application has been unsuccessful.
examples.phonetic: /wiː rɪˈɡrɛt tʊ ɪnˈfɔːm juː ðæt jɔːr ˌæplɪˈkeɪʃən hæz biːn ˌʌnsəkˈsɛsfəl/
examples.translation: A bɛ se ka k'a yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la.
examples.note: Kɔfale ka leti ka fɔlɔw kanubali. Mɛn k'a yira kontrasi ('has been' aw ka 'hasn't').

examples.original: Would you be so kind as to sign the attached document?
examples.phonetic: /wʊd juː biː səʊ kaɪnd æz tə saɪn ði əˈtætʃt ˈdɒkjʊmənt/
examples.translation: A bɛ se ka k'a yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la?
examples.note: Kɔfale ka kɛlɛya ka fɔlɔw kanubali. A taali gi, a bɛ se ka k'a yira 'usted', amma a bɛ se ka k'a yira 'would you be so kind' aw ka kɔfale ka fɔlɔw kanubali.

examples.original: Please send me the updated version of the file.
examples.phonetic: /pliːz sɛnd miː ði ˌʌpˈdeɪtɪd ˈvɜːʃən əv ðə faɪl/
examples.translation: Ayɛ k'a mɛn fɔlɔw i ka fayili ka versii ka kɛlɛya.
examples.note: Kɛlɛya: klaru n'a direkitu, amma jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubali. Kontrasi n'a jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubali.

examples.original: I'll forward you the details as soon as I get them.
examples.phonetic: /aɪl ˈfɔːwərd juː ðə ˈdiːteɪlz æz suːn æz aɪ ɡɛt ðɛm/
examples.translation: Ayɛ k'a mɛn fɔlɔw i ka dɔmɔsiw k'a fɔlɔw.
examples.note: Kontrasi ('I'll') n'a frasali verbi ('get them' aw ka 'obtain'), amma jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubali.

examples.original: The meeting has been postponed until next week.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ hæz biːn pəʊstˈpəʊnd ənˈtɪl nɛkst wiːk/
examples.translation: Jaabi bɛ yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la.
examples.note: Pasiva dɔmɔsi dɔmɔsiw ka lamɛn waati bɛ yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la.

examples.original: Wanna grab a coffee later?
examples.phonetic: /ˈwɒnə ɡræb ə ˈkɒfi ˈleɪtər/
examples.translation: A bɛ se ka k'a yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la?
examples.note: Kontrasi ('wanna') n'a jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubali ('grab' aw ka 'have').

examples.original: I can't make it to the party tonight, sorry!
examples.phonetic: /aɪ kɑːnt meɪk ɪt tə ðə ˈpɑːti təˈnaɪt ˈsɒri/
examples.translation: Ayɛ k'a mɛn fɔlɔw i ka fayisi ka kɛlɛya, ayɛ k'a mɛn fɔlɔw!
examples.note: Kontrasi ('can't'), frasali verbi ('make it') n'a jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubali ('sorry').

examples.original: That's a really cool idea, let's do that!
examples.phonetic: /ðæts ə ˈrɪəli kuːl aɪˈdɪə lɛts duː ðæt/
examples.translation: A bɛ se ka k'a yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la!
examples.note: Jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubali ('cool' aw ka 'excellent' 'good'). Kontrasi n'a jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubali ka lamɛn waati bɛ yira jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw ka jɔn ka dɔmɔsi kanubaliw la.

title: Advanced Inversion and Fronting / Inversɔn dɔn dɛmɛ na frontalization dɔn dɛmɛ
bridge: A lɛŋgɛ kan dɔ, inversɔn (kɛ auxilary verb ka kɛ sujɛ tiɲɛ) tɛ sɔrɔ min bɛɛ se ka kɛrɛnkɛrɛnniw la, amma mɛn bɛɛ ka kɛlɛ ka kɛmɛkɛrɛmɔw kɛ ka tɔgɔ lafasa. A sɛnkɛfɛ kan dɔ, i kɔrɔla jɔna bɛɛ se ka kɛlɛ ka kɛmɛkɛrɛmɔw kɛ ka tɔgɔ lafasa, sɛbɛnna i ka sira kɔrɔla jɔna bɛɛ se ka kɛlɛ ka kɛmɛkɛrɛmɔw kɛ ka tɔgɔ lafasa. Tɛmɛna, 'Rarely have I seen such beauty' a sɛnkɛfɛ kan dɔ ka kɛ 'Rara vez he visto tal belleza', sɛbɛnna inversɔn tɛn kɛ. Kɔrɔla jɔna bɛɛ se ka kɛlɛ ka kɛmɛkɛrɛmɔw kɛ ka tɔgɔ lafasa, sɛbɛnna a lɛŋgɛ kan dɔ, inversɔn tɛn kɛ sɔrɔ min bɛɛ se ka kɛrɛnkɛrɛnniw la, amma mɛn bɛɛ ka kɛlɛ ka kɛmɛkɛrɛmɔw kɛ ka tɔgɔ lafasa. Jɔn ka bɔra don: tɛ kɔrɔla jɔna bɛɛ se ka kɛlɛ ka kɛmɛkɛrɛmɔw kɛ ka tɔgɔ lafasa, tɛ inversɔn tɛn kɛ sɔrɔ min bɛɛ se ka kɛrɛnkɛrɛnniw la.
rule: A lɛŋgɛ kan dɔ, inversɔn tɛn kɛ sɔrɔ min bɛɛ se ka kɛrɛnkɛrɛnniw la, amma mɛn bɛɛ ka kɛlɛ ka kɛmɛkɛrɛmɔw kɛ ka tɔgɔ lafasa (adverbs negatifs, expressions de restriction, or adverbs de fréquence avec connotation négative) ka kɛ sɔrɔminw ka kɛrɛnkɛrɛnniw la. A kɔrɔla jɔna bɛɛ se ka kɛlɛ ka kɛmɛkɛrɛmɔw kɛ ka tɔgɔ lafasa, auxilary verb (nka verb 'be') ka kɛ sujɛ tiɲɛ, sɛbɛnna kɛrɛnkɛrɛnniw ka kɛmɛkɛrɛmɔw kɛ. A kɔrɔla jɔna bɛɛ se ka kɛlɛ ka kɛmɛkɛrɛmɔw kɛ ka tɔgɔ lafasa: 1) Adverbs negatifs: 'never', 'rarely', 'seldom', 'hardly', 'scarcely', 'barely', 'no sooner' - tɛmɛna: 'Never have I seen such a mess'. 2) Expressions de restriction: 'not only...but also', 'only after', 'only by', 'only when' - tɛmɛna: 'Only after the war did they return'. 3) Expressions de fréquence avec 'so' or 'such' - tɛmɛna: 'So beautiful was the sunset that we stopped'. 4) Avec 'not until' or 'not since' - tɛmɛna: 'Not until midnight did the party end'. 5) Avec 'in no way', 'on no account', 'under no circumstances'. Sɛbɛnna auxilary verb tɛn kɛ, 'do/does/did' ka kɛrɛnkɛrɛnniw la ka kɛmɛkɛrɛmɔw kɛ. A inversɔn walisa ka kɛlɛ ka kɛmɛkɛrɛmɔw kɛ ka tɔgɔ lafasa, amma mɛn bɛɛ ka kɛlɛ ka kɛmɛkɛrɛmɔw kɛ ka tɔgɔ lafasa. 'Frontalization' bɛɛ se ka kɛlɛ ka kɛmɛkɛrɛmɔw kɛ ka tɔgɔ lafasa, sɛbɛnna inversɔn tɛn kɛ, tɛmɛna 'That book I would never read' (sɛbɛnna 'I would never read that book').

title: Complex Nominalization (process → processing) / Nominalizasiɔ̃ komplekse (fasɔ → fasɔrɔ)
bridge: Diispaɲɛ kan, veribw dɔnɔmiinasiyɔ̃ bɛ se je ka fɔsiga -ción, -miento, an ka infinitifɔ (màlɔyafɛ: procesar → procesamiento). Nka, aŋkɛlifɔni kan bɛ se je ka fɔsiga -ing (jèjɛmɔsiri) ka minw bɛ ka sɛbɛn, u ka diispaɲɛ kan sɔrɔ bɛ se je ka fɔsiga infinitifɔ an ka sɛbɛn u ka fɔsiga. Kɔrɔsi kɛlɛya bɛɛ ka minw se aŋkɛlifɔni kan jèjɛmɔsiri bɛrɛ bɛɛ ka sɛbɛn, sɔrɔ an ka diispaɲɛ kan infinitifɔ no bɛrɛ bɛɛ ka sɛbɛn. A bɛɛ ka minw se aŋkɛlifɔni bɛrɛ bɛɛ ka sɛbɛn jèjɛmɔsiriw ka kɔrɔsifɛ an ka sɛbɛnw ka fɔsiga (màlɔyafɛ: "data processing speed"), u ka diispaɲɛ kan sɔrɔ bɛrɛ bɛɛ ka sɛbɛn. Bɔrɔ bɛɛ ka minw se jèjɛmɔsiri ka sɛbɛn (the processing) an ka sɛbɛn u ka fɔsiga (the processing plant), u ka kɔrɔsi bɛɛ ka minw se a ma fɔlɔ.
rule: Aŋkɛlifɔni kan, nominalizasiɔ̃ komplekse bɛ se je ka fɔsiga fasɔ, jèjɛmɔ an ka tɔgɔ bɛ se je ka fɔsiga sɛbɛn jèjɛmɔsiri (-ing) an ka sɛbɛnw ka fɔsiga -tion, -ment, -ness, -ity an ka -al. Jèjɛmɔsiri u ka fɔsiga bɛrɛ bɛɛ ka sɛbɛn: (1) sɛbɛn: "Processing data requires time"; (2) sɛbɛn u ka fɔsiga: "I enjoy processing information"; (3) kɔrɔsifɛ u ka fɔsiga: "She is responsible for processing orders"; (4) sɛbɛn u ka fɔsiga: "a processing plant". Kɔnɔsira an ka akademisi (C1) kan, u ka fɔsiga bɛ se je ka fɔsiga tɛmɛ jɔn: "The processing of sensitive data is regulated" kelen "You must process sensitive data in a regulated way". Fasɔ tɛmɛw kan, aŋkɛlifɔni bɛrɛ bɛɛ ka sɛbɛn jèjɛmɔsiri (the processing) sɔrɔ an ka sɛbɛnw ka fɔsiga (the processing, the analysis, the development). Kɔrɔsi: veribw ka minw bɛrɛ bɛɛ ka sɛbɛn (to decide → decision, to explain → explanation) an ka minw se u ka fɔsiga -ing ("the deciding" kɔ). A bɛɛ ka minw se u ka fɔsiga bɛrɛ bɛɛ ka sɛbɛn: to grow → growth, to lose → loss, to choose → choice. Sɛbɛnw ka fɔsiga kan, jèjɛmɔsiri bɛrɛ bɛɛ ka sɛbɛn sɛbɛn (processing unit) an ka sɛbɛn u ka fɔsiga (data processing). Jèjɛmɔsiri an ka sɛbɛn bɛrɛ bɛɛ ka sɛbɛn, a bɛ se je ka fɔsiga 'of': "the processing of data" bɛrɛ bɛɛ ka sɛbɛn "data processing" kɔnɔsira kan. Diispaɲɛ kan, u ka fɔsiga bɛ se je ka fɔsiga infinitifɔ: "procesar datos" an ka sɛbɛnw ka fɔsiga: "el procesamiento de datos".

examples.translation: Tɛmɛ jɔn bɛ se je ka fɔsiga tɛmɛ jɔn bɛrɛ bɛɛ ka sɛbɛn.
examples.note: Kɔrɔsifɛ 'on' (depend on) bɛ se je ka fɔsiga jèjɛmɔsiri. Kɔrɔsi kɛlɛya bɛɛ ka minw se a ma fɔlɔ 'to plan'; u ka fɔsiga bɛ se je ka fɔsiga 'depend on + -ing'.

levels.translation: Sɛbɛnw ka fɔsiga an ka sɛbɛnw ka fɔsiga

examples.original: The decision-making process was slow and bureaucratic.
examples.phonetic: ðə dɪˈsɪʒənˌmeɪkɪŋ ˈprəʊsɛs wɒz sləʊ ænd ˌbjʊərəˈkrætɪk
examples.translation: Tɛmɛ jɔn ka fasɔrɔ bɛrɛ bɛɛ ka sɛbɛn an ka tɛmɛ jɔn.
examples.note: Sɛbɛn 'decision-making' bɛ se je ka fɔsiga sɛbɛn an ka jèjɛmɔsiri; diispaɲɛ kan bɛ se je ka fɔsiga 'toma de decisiones'.

examples.original: Improving the company's efficiency was the main objective.
examples.phonetic: ɪmˈpruːvɪŋ ðə ˈkʌmpəniz ɪˈfɪʃənsi wɒz ðə meɪn əbˈdʒɛktɪv
examples.translation: Tɛmɛ jɔn bɛ se je ka fɔsiga tɛmɛ jɔn bɛrɛ bɛɛ ka sɛbɛn.
examples.note: Sɛbɛn 'efficiency' bɛ se je ka fɔsiga sɛbɛn (u ka fɔsiga -cy) u ka diispaɲɛ kan sɔrɔ bɛ se je ka fɔsiga 'eficiencia'. Jèjɛmɔsiri 'improving' bɛ se je ka fɔsiga sɛbɛn an ka sɛbɛn.

examples.original: The implementation of new policies requires careful planning.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˌɪmplɪmɛnˈteɪʃən əv njuː ˈpɒlɪsiz rɪˈkwaɪəz ˈkeəfʊl ˈplænɪŋ
examples.translation: Tɛmɛ jɔn bɛ se je ka fɔsiga tɛmɛ jɔn bɛrɛ bɛɛ ka sɛbɛn.
examples.note: Bɔrɔ bɛɛ ka minw se u ka fɔsiga: 'implementation' (sɛbɛn u ka fɔsiga -tion, diispaɲɛ kan sɔrɔ bɛ se je ka fɔsiga) an ka 'planning' (jèjɛmɔsiri). 'Of' u ka fɔsiga aŋkɛlifɔni kan 'implementation of' bɛ se je ka fɔsiga 'de' diispaɲɛ kan.

examples.original: Understanding the issue requires examining all perspectives.
examples.phonetic: ˌʌndəˈstændɪŋ ði ˈɪʃuː rɪˈkwaɪəz ɪɡˈzæmɪnɪŋ ɔːl pəˈspɛktɪvz
examples.translation: Kɛlɛya tɛmɛ jɔn bɛ se je ka fɔsiga kɛlɛya tɛmɛ jɔn bɛrɛ bɛɛ ka sɛbɛn.
examples.note: Jèjɛmɔsiriw ka minw bɛ ka sɛbɛn: 'understanding' ka minw bɛ ka sɛbɛn, 'examining' ka minw bɛ ka sɛbɛn 'requires'. Diispaɲɛ kan, u ka fɔsiga bɛ se je ka fɔsiga infinitifɔ.

title: Ellipsis and Substitution (so do I, neither have we) / Elipsis nɛ substituisi
bridge: Sipanɛ, an bena kanbɛlɛ ni ma “tɛmɛkɛ” “muso” fɔlɔ fanga kanbɛlɛ ni ma “tɛmɛkɛ” “muso” fɔlɔ, amma aŋkɔlɔfɛ kanbɛlɛ ni ma “do/does/did” fɔlɔ sira kɛlɛniɔgɔn fɔlɔ. Kɛlɛya kɔrɔni bɛɛ, a bena kanbɛlɛ ni ma “so do I” “neither have we” fɔlɔ, nka tɛna kɛlɛniɔgɔn fɔlɔ. Kɛlɛya kɔrɔni bɛɛ, a bena kanbɛlɛ ni ma “so do I” “neither have we” fɔlɔ, nka tɛna kɛlɛniɔgɔn fɔlɔ.
rule: Aŋkɔlɔfɛ kanbɛlɛ ni ma “so do I” “neither have we” fɔlɔ sira kɛlɛniɔgɔn fɔlɔ. Kɛlɛya kɔrɔni bɛɛ, a bena kanbɛlɛ ni ma “so do I” “neither have we” fɔlɔ, nka tɛna kɛlɛniɔgɔn fɔlɔ. Kɛlɛya kɔrɔni bɛɛ, a bena kanbɛlɛ ni ma “so do I” “neither have we” fɔlɔ, nka tɛna kɛlɛniɔgɔn fɔlɔ.

concept_examples.text: I love travelling, and so does my brother.
concept_examples.translation: Mɛn kɛlɛ ni fɛ, nɛ mɛn wɔtɔgɔ tɛmɛkɛ.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ lʌv ˈtrævəlɪŋ ænd səʊ dʌz maɪ ˈbrʌðər/

concept_examples.text: We haven't finished the project, and neither have they.
concept_examples.translation: An yɛrɛ tɛ sɔrɔ prɔzhɛ, nɛ i tɛmɛkɛ.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wi ˈhævənt ˈfɪnɪʃt ðə ˈprɒdʒekt ænd ˈnaɪðə hæv ðeɪ/

concept_examples.text: She didn't study for the exam, but I did.
concept_examples.translation: A yɛrɛ tɛ bɛɛnɛ eɲɔgɔn, amma ayɛ.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃi ˈdɪdnt ˈstʌdi fə ði ɪɡˈzæm bʌt aɪ dɪd/

concept_examples.text: I can speak three languages, and so can she.

concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ kən spiːk θriː ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒɪz ænd səʊ kən ʃiː/

common_error.wrong: I like coffee, and also my friend likes.
common_error.correct: I like coffee, and so does my friend.
common_error.correct_alt: I like coffee, and my friend does too.
common_error.explanation: Fɛɛrɛ la tɛna “nɛ mɛn wɔtɔgɔ tɛmɛkɛ” “nɛ mɛn wɔtɔgɔ tɛmɛkɛ” fɔlɔ. Aŋkɔlɔfɛ kanbɛlɛ ni ma “so” (afirmativo) “too” fɔlɔ sira kɛlɛniɔgɔn fɔlɔ. Tɛna “also” “like” fɔlɔ sira kɛlɛniɔgɔn fɔlɔ. Kɛlɛya kɔrɔni bɛɛ, a bena kanbɛlɛ ni ma “does” fɔlɔ sira kɛlɛniɔgɔn fɔlɔ.

examples.original: He has visited Paris, and so have I.
examples.phonetic: /hi hæz ˈvɪzɪtɪd ˈpærɪs ænd səʊ hæv aɪ/
examples.translation: A bɛna Pari, nɛ ayɛ tɛmɛkɛ.
examples.note: ‘Have’ bena kanbɛlɛ ni ma presente perfecto fɔlɔ. Auxiliar bena kanbɛlɛ ni ma sujet fɔlɔ.

examples.original: They will arrive early, and so will we.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ wɪl əˈraɪv ˈɜːli ænd səʊ wɪl wiː/
examples.translation: I bɛna tɛ sabali sanu, nɛ an tɛmɛkɛ.

examples.original: She works hard, and so do I.

examples.translation: A bɛna tɛ fɛ, nɛ ayɛ tɛmɛkɛ.
examples.note: Present simple bɛɛ, ‘do’ bena kanbɛlɛ ni ma I/you/we/they fɔlɔ, amma ‘does’ bena kanbɛlɛ ni ma he/she/it fɔlɔ.

examples.original: We don't like spicy food, and neither does Mary.
examples.phonetic: /wi dəʊnt laɪk ˈspaɪsi fuːd ænd ˈnaɪðə dʌz ˈmeəri/
examples.translation: An yɛrɛ tɛ kɛlɛ ni fɛ, nɛ Mari tɛmɛkɛ.

examples.original: I can't swim, and nor can my sister.

examples.original: They haven't finished, and neither has he.

examples.note: Presente perfecto bɛɛ, ‘has’ bena kanbɛlɛ ni ma he/she/it fɔlɔ, amma ‘have’ bena kanbɛlɛ ni ma i blon fɔlɔ.

examples.original: She speaks French better than I do.
examples.phonetic: /ʃi spiːks frenʃ ˈbɛtə ðən aɪ duː/
examples.translation: A kan tɛ sabali fraŋse kan mɛn.
examples.note: ‘Do’ bena kanbɛlɛ ni ma ‘speak’ fɔlɔ sira kɛlɛniɔgɔn fɔlɔ.

examples.original: He didn't break the vase, but his brother did.
examples.phonetic: /hi ˈdɪdnt breɪk ðə vɑːz bʌt hɪz ˈbrʌðə dɪd/

examples.note: Yɛrɛ tɛ bɛɛ, ‘did’ bena kanbɛlɛ ni ma verbo fɔlɔ.

examples.original: Do you think it will rain? - I think so.
examples.phonetic: /duː juː θɪŋk ɪt wɪl reɪn aɪ θɪŋk səʊ/
examples.translation: I ɲɛfɛmɔgɔn bɛna tɛ fɛɛnɛ? - Ayɛ ɲɛfɛmɔgɔn bɛna tɛ fɛɛnɛ.
examples.note: ‘So’ bena kanbɛlɛ ni ma cláusula completa (‘it will rain’) fɔlɔ sira kɛlɛniɔgɔn fɔlɔ.

title: Advanced Discourse Markers for Cohesion / Marikadenw bɔrɔsiw ka kɔfɛ
bridge: A taali gi, marikadenw bɔrɔsiw tɛmɛ wàrti fana ka minw fana dɔrɔn: 'no obstante', 'por consiguiente' la 'a saber' bɛ fɔlɔ fɔlɔn kɛ ka minw ye. Nka, a taali gi ye, marikadenw bɔrɔsiw tɛmɛ wàrti fana ka minw fana dɔrɔn bɛna bɛrɛbɛrɛnin tɔgɔ la tɔɔrɔnin tɛ, an ka bɔrɔsiw la an ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka. An ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka fana, marikadenw bɔrɔsiw tɛmɛ wàrti fana ka minw fana dɔrɔn tɛmɛ wàrti fana ka minw fana dɔrɔn bɛna bɛrɛbɛrɛnin tɛ, an ka bɔrɔsiw la an ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka. Taga, marikadenw bɔrɔsiw tɛmɛ wàrti fana ka minw fana dɔrɔn tɛmɛ wàrti fana ka minw fana dɔrɔn bɛna bɛrɛbɛrɛnin tɛ, an ka bɔrɔsiw la an ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka.
rule: Marikadenw bɔrɔsiw tɛmɛ wàrti fana ka minw fana dɔrɔn (C1) bɛna: 1) Marikadenw bɔrɔsiw tɛmɛ wàrti fana ka minw fana dɔrɔn ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka: 'nevertheless', 'nonetheless', 'whereas', 'while', 'on the contrary', 'in contrast' (bɛna seka ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka, 'whereas' la 'while' bɛna seka ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka). 2) Marikadenw bɔrɔsiw tɛmɛ wàrti fana ka minw fana dɔrɔn ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka: 'consequently', 'therefore', 'thus', 'hence', 'accordingly', 'as a result' (bɛna seka ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka; 'thus' la 'hence' bɛna seka ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka la bɛna seka ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka). 3) Marikadenw bɔrɔsiw tɛmɛ wàrti fana ka minw fana dɔrɔn ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka: 'furthermore', 'moreover', 'in addition', 'besides' (bɛna seka ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka; 'besides' bɛna seka ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka). 4) Marikadenw bɔrɔsiw tɛmɛ wàrti fana ka minw fana dɔrɔn ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka: 'in other words', 'that is', 'namely', 'to put it differently' (bɛna seka ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka). 5) Marikadenw bɔrɔsiw tɛmɛ wàrti fana ka minw fana dɔrɔn ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka: 'for instance', 'for example', 'such as' (bɛna seka ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka). 6) Marikadenw bɔrɔsiw tɛmɛ wàrti fana ka minw fana dɔrɔn ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka: 'incidentally', 'by the way', 'meanwhile', 'in the meantime' (bɛna seka ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka). 7) Marikadenw bɔrɔsiw tɛmɛ wàrti fana ka minw fana dɔrɔn ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka: 'admittedly', 'granted', 'even though' (bɛna seka ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka). 8) Marikadenw bɔrɔsiw tɛmɛ wàrti fana ka minw fana dɔrɔn ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka: 'indeed', 'in fact', 'actually' (bɛna seka ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka). 9) Marikadenw bɔrɔsiw tɛmɛ wàrti fana ka minw fana dɔrɔn ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka: 'in conclusion', 'to sum up', 'in summary', 'ultimately' (bɛna seka ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka). Bɛrɛbɛrɛnin tɔgɔ, bɛna seka ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka; bɛrɛbɛrɛnin tɔgɔ, bɛna seka ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka; bɛrɛbɛrɛnin tɔgɔ, bɛna seka ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka. A taali gi, marikadenw bɔrɔsiw tɛmɛ wàrti fana ka minw fana dɔrɔn bɛna 'sin embargo', 'no obstante', 'además', 'por lo tanto', 'es decir', 'por ejemplo' la tɛmɛ wàrti fana ka minw fana dɔrɔn, nka bɛrɛbɛrɛnin la tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka.

concept_examples.text: The project was challenging; nevertheless, the team managed to deliver it on time.
concept_examples.translation: Jɔnjɔnkan bɛɛ, a kunna furu ka tila sɔrɔ la, i kɛ fɔlɔ fɔlɔn ye.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈprɒdʒekt wɒz ˈtʃælɪndʒɪŋ; ˌnevəðəˈles, ðə tiːm ˈmænɪdʒd tə dɪˈlɪvər ɪt ɒn taɪm/

concept_examples.text: Whereas the previous report was optimistic, this one highlights several risks.
concept_examples.translation: A taali gi, kɔfɛyɛtiɲɛ filimu ye ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka, o bɛɛ, o kɛ fɔlɔ fɔn ye.
concept_examples.phonetic: /weərˈæz ðə ˈpriːviəs rɪˈpɔːt wɒz ˌɒptɪˈmɪstɪk, ðɪs wʌn ˈhaɪlaɪts ˈsevrəl rɪsks/

concept_examples.text: The company's profits have increased; consequently, they plan to expand.
concept_examples.translation: Jɔnjɔnkan bɛɛ, a kunna furu ka tila sɔrɔ la, i kɛ fɔlɔ fɔlɔn ye.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈkʌmpəniz ˈprɒfɪts hæv ɪnˈkriːst; ˈkɒnsɪkwəntli, ðeɪ plæn tə ɪkˈspænd/

concept_examples.text: He is an excellent candidate; indeed, his experience surpasses all others.
concept_examples.translation: A taali gi, kɔfɛyɛtiɲɛ filimu ye ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka, o bɛɛ, o kɛ fɔlɔ fɔn ye.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiː ɪz ən ˈeksələnt kændɪdət; ɪnˈdiːd, hɪz ɪkˈspɪəriəns səˈpɑːsɪz ɔːl ˈʌðəz/

common_error.wrong: Although the weather was bad, but we went to the beach.
common_error.correct: Although the weather was bad, we went to the beach.
common_error.correct_alt: The weather was bad; nevertheless, we went to the beach.
common_error.explanation: Kɔrɔsi kɛra ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka, a taali gi, 'Aunque hacía mal tiempo, pero fuimos a la playa' (kɔrɔsi kɛra ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka). A taali gi ye, 'although' la 'but' bɛna seka ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka. Kɔrɔsi kɛra ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka, 'but' bɛna seka ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka, la 'nevertheless' bɛna seka ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka. 'Although' bɛna seka ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka, la kɔfɛyɛtiɲɛ filimu ye ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka.

levels.label: Contrast Markers
levels.translation: Marikadenw bɔrɔsiw tɛmɛ wàrti fana ka minw fana dɔrɔn ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka

examples.original: She is very introverted; however, she gives excellent presentations.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ɪz ˈveri ˈɪntrəvɜːtɪd; haʊˈevə, ʃiː gɪvz ˈeksələnt ˌprezenˈteɪʃənz/
examples.translation: A yɛrɛ tɛmɛ, o bɛɛ, o kɛ fɔlɔ fɔlɔn ye.
examples.note: 'However' bɛna seka ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka, la a taali gi ye, 'sin embargo' bɛna seka ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka.

examples.original: Unlike the North, the South of the country enjoys mild winters.
examples.phonetic: /ʌnˈlaɪk ðə nɔːθ, ðə saʊθ əv ðə ˈkʌntri ɪnˈdʒɔɪz maɪld ˈwɪntəz/
examples.translation: A taali gi, kɔfɛyɛtiɲɛ filimu ye ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka, o bɛɛ, o kɛ fɔlɔ fɔn ye.
examples.note: 'Unlike' bɛna seka ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka, la a taali gi ye, 'a diferencia de' bɛna seka ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka.

examples.original: He didn't fail the exam; on the contrary, he got the highest mark.
examples.phonetic: /hiː ˈdɪdnt feɪl ði ɪɡˈzæm; ɒn ðə ˈkɒntrəri, hiː gɒt ðə ˈhaɪɪst mɑːk/
examples.translation: A taali gi, kɔfɛyɛtiɲɛ filimu ye ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka, o bɛɛ, o kɛ fɔlɔ fɔn ye.
examples.note: 'On the contrary' bɛna seka ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka, la a taali gi ye, 'al contrario' bɛna seka ka tɔgɔ bɛrɛw bɛna seka.

levels.label: Consequence and Addition Markers

examples.original: The new policy has reduced costs; therefore, the company can invest more in R&D.

rule:
Angilɛkan, kɛlɛya kelen kelen kanbaya bɛ fɔlɔw fana ka lamɛn dɔw mayɛlɪmanw:
- Kɛlɛya kelen kelen kanbaya bɛ fɔlɔw fana ka lamɛn dɔw mayɛlɪmanw: may, might, could (kanozo), should (kanozo).
- Kɛlɛya kelen kelen kanbaya bɛ fɔlɔw fana ka lamɛn dɔw mayɛlɪmanw: perhaps, possibly, presumably, arguably, maybe.
- Kɛlɛya kelen kelen kanbaya bɛ fɔlɔw fana ka lamɛn dɔw mayɛlɪmanw: I think, I believe, I suppose, I would say, I tend to think.

- Kɛlɛya kelen kelen kanbaya bɛ fɔlɔw fana ka lamɛn dɔw mayɛlɪmanw: possible, likely, unlikely, debatable, questionable.
- Kɛlɛya kelen kelen kanbaya bɛ fɔlɔw fana ka lamɛn dɔw mayɛlɪmanw: Would you mind... I wondered...

title: Complex Verb Patterns: Double Objects / Faranw dɔɲɛɲuman tɛmɛ jɛnɲɔgɔnw: sira sɔgɔsɔgɔ
bridge: Tɛ Espaniye ke, i sɛbɛn' mɛn' bɛɛ i ja gɛlɛn' koo 'a' wala 'para' la don sɔgɔsɔgɔ fɛ, n'i kɛlɛn' bɛɛ tɛmɛ tɛmɛ fɛ. Tɛ Angalɛ kan, faranw bɛɛ u ka jɛnɲɔgɔn kanbɛ sira sɔgɔsɔgɔ: 'give something to somebody' wala 'give somebody something', nka, faranw bɛɛ tɛntɛ u ka sira sɔgɔsɔgɔ sira sɔgɔsɔgɔ fɛ. Nka, tɛ Angalɛ kan, sɔgɔsɔgɔ fɛn' bɛɛ tɛn' na tɛmɛ fɛ, a bɛɛ tɛmɛ tɛn' bɛ sɔgɔsɔgɔ fɛ, n'u sira k'a laban tɛ Hispanikanw kɛlɛn' bɛɛ i sɔgɔsɔgɔ fɛn' bɛ tɛmɛ fɛ. Faranw dɔɲɛɲumanw tɛmɛ jɛnɲɔgɔnw: faranw dɔɲɛɲumanw tɛmɛ 'explain' wala 'suggest' tɛn' sira sɔgɔsɔgɔ sɔgɔsɔgɔ fɛ ('explain me' tɛ haɲɔn ye), nka tɛ Espaniye kan, 'explícame' tɛ haɲɔn ye.
rule: Tɛ Angalɛ kan, faranw ditransitifw ka kɛlɛn' bɛɛ sira sɔgɔsɔgɔ sira sɔgɔsɔgɔ: (1) faranw + sɔgɔsɔgɔ fɛn' (jɛnɲɔgɔ) + sɔgɔsɔgɔ tɛmɛ (sɛbɛn') — 'give John a book' — n' (2) faranw + sɔgɔsɔgɔ tɛmɛ + 'to/for' + sɔgɔsɔgɔ fɛn' — 'give a book to John'. Faranw bɛɛ tɛntɛ u ka sira sɔgɔsɔgɔ sira sɔgɔsɔgɔ fɛ. Faranw dɔɲɛɲumanw tɛmɛ 'give', 'send', 'show', 'tell', 'teach', 'lend', 'pass', 'offer', 'owe', 'promise' sira sɔgɔsɔgɔ sira sɔgɔsɔgɔ fɛ. Faranw dɔɲɛɲumanw tɛmɛ 'explain', 'describe', 'suggest', 'mention', 'announce', 'report', 'say', 'admit', 'confess' sira sɔgɔsɔgɔ fɛn' 'to' fɛ (i tɛn' sira sɔgɔsɔgɔ sɔgɔsɔgɔ fɛ). Tɛ 'buy', 'get', 'make', 'cook', 'find', 'save' kan, i sɛbɛn' 'for' tɛmɛ sɔgɔsɔgɔ fɛn' koo (e.g., 'buy a gift for her' wala 'buy her a gift'). Sɔgɔsɔgɔ tɛmɛ bɛɛ tɛn' na tɛmɛ fɛ (it, them), a bɛɛ tɛmɛ tɛn' bɛ sɔgɔsɔgɔ fɛ, a bɛɛ tɛmɛ tɛn' bɛ sɔgɔsɔgɔ fɛ: 'give it to me', tɛ 'give me it'. Faranw dɔɲɛɲumanw bɛɛ tɛn' na tɛmɛ fɛ koo 'provide somebody with something' wala 'explain something to somebody'.

title: Nuances of Tense and Aspect / Kɔlɔŋfɛ ni a bɔ a bilara kanu
bridge: Espaɲɛ kan, kɔlɔŋfɛ perfectifɔ ni imperfectifɔ beeri wo ka taa kelen ye ko tɛmɛ tɛmɛla (pretérito indefinido ni imperfecto), sigi ye Mɔɲɔkɔw bɛɛ, kɔlɔŋfɛ bɛ ka taa ka kɛlɛyaŋ bɛ ka taa progressive ('-ing') ni perfect ('have + -ed') jati fana. Hispanofɔw ye mɔgɔw bɛɛ, a ma sira kɛ a ka taa ka kɛlɛyaŋ bɛ ka taa simple past bɛɛ minw bɛ ka taa ka jamana ka kɛlɛyaŋ bɛ ka taa (nka «I worked» o tɛ, a taa tɛ «I was working») nɔgɔna a ma sira kɛ present perfect (he comido) ni simple past (comí) Mɔɲɔkɔw bɛɛ. Kɔrɔkɛw ye fana minw bɛ yɛrɛ fana, Mɔɲɔkɔw caaman bɛrɛbɛ ka kɔlɔŋfɛ «pretérito pluscuamperfecto» ka taa kelen Espaɲɛ kan kɔlɔŋfɛw ka taa, o kɔrɔ, a ka taa past perfect ka taa kelen minw Espaɲɛ kan kɔlɔŋfɛ indefinite ni imperfect kɔlɔŋfɛw ka taa.
rule: 1. **Progressive vs. Simple Aspect**: Mɔɲɔkɔw bɛɛ, present progressive (am/is/are + -ing) ka taa kelen ka jamana ka kɛlɛyaŋ bɛ ka taa, o kɔrɔ present simple (base form, -s fɔlɔ third person) ka taa kelen ka jamana ka jamana ni ka tɔgɔtɔgɔn fɛ. Ko taa ka jamana bɛɛ, 'was/were + -ing' ka taa kelen ka jamana ka kɛlɛyaŋ ka taa ka jamana ka tɔɔrɔ, o kɔrɔ simple past (verb in -ed ni irregular) ka taa kelen ka jamana ka jamana ni ka tɔgɔtɔgɔn fɛ. 2. **Perfect Aspects**: 'Present perfect' (have/has + -ed) ka taa kelen ka jamana ka jamana ni ka tɔgɔtɔgɔn fɛ ka jamana ka tɔɔrɔ (resultats ni experiences ka tɛmɛ tɛmɛla). 'Past perfect' (had + -ed) ka taa kelen ka jamana ka jamana ni ka tɔgɔtɔgɔn fɛ ka jamana ka tɔɔrɔ. Espaɲɛ kan, present perfect (he hecho) ni pluscuamperfecto (había hecho) ka taa kelen, nka a bɛɛ ka taa kelen ye mɔgɔ. 3. **Stative verbs** (like, know, believe, want): a taa ka taa ka kɛlɛyaŋ bɛ ka taa ye mɔgɔ, o kɔrɔ, a bɛɛ ka taa ka kɛlɛyaŋ ka taa ka jamana ka tɔgɔtɔgɔn fɛ (nka «be having» vs. «have»). 4. **Expressing Future**: Mɔɲɔkɔw bɛɛ, present continuous (ka taa ka jamana ka tɔgɔtɔgɔn fɛ), 'be going to' (intentions), ni 'will' (spontaneous decisions, predictions) ka taa kelen ka jamana ka tɔgɔtɔgɔn fɛ. 5. **Aspect with 'used to' and 'would'**: Ka taa ka jamana ka tɔgɔtɔgɔn fɛ ka taa ka jamana ka tɔgɔtɔgɔn fɛ, 'used to' (solía) ni 'would' (solía) ka taa kelen ka jamana ka jamana ni ka tɔgɔtɔgɔn fɛ. 6. **Narration**: Ka taa ka jamana ka tɔgɔtɔgɔn fɛ ka taa ka jamana ka tɔgɔtɔgɔn fɛ, simple past (ka taa ka jamana ka tɔgɔtɔgɔn fɛ) ni past progressive (ka taa ka jamana ka tɔgɔtɔgɔn fɛ) ka taa kelen. Past perfect ka taa kelen ka jamana ka jamana ni ka tɔgɔtɔgɔn fɛ. Espaɲɛ kan kɔlɔŋfɛw ye mɔgɔ minw bɛ ka taa kelen ye mɔgɔ.

title: Advanced Passives / Pasiva kanbaliw
bridge: Espagnol la, 'se dice que' wala 'es sabido que' sanankuya baman ye a fana ka tɛmɛ kɛra don fɔlɔ fɔlɔ bɛɛ. Anglise la, an bɛn ye a fana ka tɛmɛw kanbali sanankuw kanu: 'it is said that', 'it is believed that', wala 'is said to be'. Kɔrɔsi kelen ye anglise kan ka tɔgɔlɔnkan bɛɛ ka tɛmɛ kanbaliw ka tɔgɔlɔnkan ye, ama espagnol la, kɔrɔsi sanankuya bɛɛ ka tɛmɛ kanbaliw ka tɔgɔlɔnkan ye. Kɔrɔsi fana ye 'there' ka lamɛn kanbali sanankuya la, an ka lamɛn kanu sira bɛɛ espagnol la.
rule: Anglise kanbali kanbaliw ka lamɛn bɛɛ ye a fana ka tɛmɛ kɛra don fɔlɔ fɔlɔ bɛɛ. Kɔrɔsi sanankuya bɛɛ ye: 1) Kanbali kanu: 'Tɛmɛ + kanbali tɛmɛ + to-infinitive' (n'a ye 'He is said to be very rich'). Kanbali sanankuw ka tɛmɛ ye kanbali ka tɛmɛ ye, tɛmɛ infinitif ye tɛmɛ kelen (to be), tɛmɛ perfect (to have been), wala tɛmɛ progressive (to be doing). 2) Kanbali sira: 'It + kanbali tɛmɛ + that-clause' (n'a ye 'It is believed that the economy will improve'). Kɔrɔsi ye espagnol 'es/es creído que' sanankuya ye, ama anglise la, an ka lamɛn kanu sira bɛɛ ye. Kɔrɔsi fana ye 'There + kanbali tɛmɛ + to be' (n'a ye 'There is said to be a shortage of water') a fana ka tɛmɛ kɛra don fɔlɔ fɔlɔ bɛɛ. Kɔrɔsi sanankuya bɛɛ ka lamɛn kanu: kanbali kanu ye kanbali sira bɛɛ ka lamɛn kanu, kanbali sira ye akademisi kanbaliw la.

examples.translation: A bɛna a ma sigi fɔlɔw bɛɛ ka tɛmɛ ye, mun na tiɲɛ kanbaliw ye.
examples.note: 'There are thought to be' ye a fana ka tɛmɛ kɛra don fɔlɔ fɔlɔ bɛɛ.

examples.original: The new law is claimed to have reduced crime by 30%.
examples.phonetic: /ðə nuː lɔ ɪz kleɪmd tə hæv rɪˈdust kraɪm baɪ ˈθɜrti pərˈsɛnt/
examples.translation: A bɛna a ma sigi fɔlɔw bɛɛ ka tɛmɛ ye, mun na tiɲɛ kanbaliw ye.
examples.note: 'Claim', 'allege', 'report' ye kɔrɔsi sanankuya bɛɛ ka lamɛn kanu.

examples.original: He is known to have worked for the government in the past.
examples.phonetic: /hi ɪz noʊn tə hæv wɜrkt fər ðə ˈgʌvərnmənt ɪn ðə pæst/
examples.translation: A bɛna a ma sigi fɔlɔw bɛɛ ka tɛmɛ ye, mun na tiɲɛ kanbaliw ye.
examples.note: 'Known' ye 'to have + past participle' ka lamɛn kanu kɛra don fɔlɔ fɔlɔ bɛɛ.
